fusions.name: Venom Dart
fusions.desc: Spits a dart of venom that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Ripened Fang
fusions.desc: A fang strike that deals 8 damage and needs one of your afflictions on the target, which it uses up. The target is 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Antivenom Sip
fusions.desc: Clears up to 3 poison conditions from you and restores 12 health.

fusions.name: Coiled Wait
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, your next ability deals 25% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
